annotations.title: Read a cruise ship's recent positions

description: A ship's saved hourly positions (up to the latest 168 hours, newest first): time, latitude, longitude, speed, course, heading and, for imported ones, the source page. The home page map draws each ship's last 3 days from these. Missing hours are never interpolated.

hours.description: Only positions from the last N hours (default all saved, up to 168)
